svg.text: UPerNet decoder total: 5,377,024 parameters · each auxiliary head: 1,542 (training only)
All decoder convolutions: no bias, then GroupNorm (8 groups) and GELU.
F1–F4 already have 256 channels, so the FPN needs
no 1×1 lateral convolutions; Fᵢ is added directly.
Sizes are for one 256 × 256 input patch.
